title: a-concept-piece-has-a-voyage
intention: Register a workflow for the concept-piece class, and give press_office the state + history it cannot journal without one. concept-piece is the ONE node class in CairnCommons/node_classes/ with no workflow_versions key (code-seam has v1+v2, skill has v1, host-seam and operational-driver are registered) — so no workflow string naming it can parse, no crossing can be emitted, and every concept-piece is structurally unable to journal. press_office/ is the visible cost: charter and proofs/ beside its code, and no state.json, no history.json.
why: Law 5 says intent, its voyage, and its proofs share an address. press_office has two of the three: a charter and a proofs/ directory, and no state.json, no history.json. The lived symptom belongs to the next reader who opens press_office/ and asks a plain question — 'when did §3 of the brief last change, and why?' Today the only answers are `git log`, which records bytes and not crossings, and a paragraph in proofs/PROOF.md that someone REMEMBERED to write. Both 2026-08-05 revisions happened to get recorded that way. The next one is recorded only if the next author remembers too, which is policy, not physics (Law 4). The structural cause sits one level up and is not press_office's fault: concept-piece.json carries no workflow_versions, so no workflow string naming that class can parse at all. Every concept-piece the system will ever cast inherits the same silence.
traces_to: Law 5 — intent, voyage and proofs share an address; press_office is missing the voyage
Law 4 — 'someone remembers to write it in PROOF.md' is exactly the policy this law says is a tracked debt, not a resting state
Law 1 — a registered class version means the parse/conform question is answered once in transitions.py rather than per document

tickets/skills-ride-the-chokepoint (2026-07-29) — the precedent: class `skill` had this identical gap, found the same way (a crossing refused with 'no registered workflow for class skill'), and was fixed by mirroring code-seam's path with the reasoning written into its own `why`

proves_green.prove_gate: code-seam's proof gate — the tester runs proofs/ and emits a VALIDATION; verdict and seal from the same hand.
proves_green.proof_gate: defect-first, two teeth: (i) a malformed concept-piece workflow string REDS through the real parser (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py — the same load_class_def + _conform the emit chokepoint and the /sorted door run, so no new validator is written); (ii) a HAND-WRITTEN press_office/state.json REDS. Tooth (ii) is the non-vacuity tooth — without it the proof is file-existence, which cannot fail once the file is written.
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: FALSIFIER, in two teeth that must both be green. (a) A workflow string 'concept-piece@v1: …' PARSES and CONFORMS through cairn/tools/base/transitions.py — the same load_class_def + _conform the emit chokepoint and the /sorted door already run, so no new validator is written and 'zero new machinery' is itself checkable. (b) press_office/state.json and history.json exist and are COMPILED, not authored: the antiproof is that the proof must red on a hand-written state.json. A proof that merely asserts the two files exist is the coin-toss-green this corpus has already met — file-existence cannot fail once a file is written. HORIZON: re-read when the second concept-piece component appears (today press_office is the only one). If registering the class turns out to demand a path that does NOT mirror code-seam@v2, that is the signal the human-proved voyage is genuinely a different shape and v1 was minted too early — the node re-enters design rather than taking a patch.

If registering the class demands a path that does NOT mirror code-seam@v2, that is the signal a human-proved voyage is genuinely a different shape and v1 was minted too early; the node re-enters design rather than taking a patch.

how: Register workflow_versions.v1 in CairnCommons/node_classes/concept-piece.json. Give press_office the voyage state + history hooks it cannot journal without a registered workflow. Children: register the workflow, then migrate the press_office documents.
